text: This report recommends that the name "Albert Kahn Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane south of Danforth Avenue extending east from Luttrell Avenue. Community Council have delegated authority to decide lane naming matters which comply with The City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Albert Kahn Lane" for the existing public lane south of Danforth Avenue extending east from Luttrell Avenue.
